text: If it is asked, "How was this division between the root part and the suffix part understood?", this question does not cause any surprise to those who have drunk the waters of Patanjala. This is because the science of grammar is well known for its dedication to explaining the division between the root and the suffix. Indeed, the first sentence of the venerable Patanjali, the author of the Mahabhashya, is: "Now, the instruction of words" (Mahabhashya 1/1/1). The meaning of this is: the word 'atha' is employed to indicate the scope of the subject.
